title: Build automation bot to sync calendar bookings between two software platforms
description: I'm running an indoor golf simulator facility using Trackman iO hardware. We use GymMaster as our primary booking/membership management system, but we've also activated Trackman's Booking & Payments platform specifically for its auto-lock screen, session timers, and anti-camping enforcement (bays lock at end of booked time via TPS integration). Trackman does not offer API support. THE JOB: I want an automated bot/virtual assistant to act as a "middleman" and pull booking data from GymMaster and enter it into the Trackman Booking & Payments admin portal so Trackman can handle the enforcement described above. Key requirements for the project: Monitor GymMaster for new bookings (using their API/webhooks/Zapier triggers if possible – GymMaster has good Zapier support and an open API for bookings). Extract relevant details: booking time, duration, bay/resource, member/customer name/email (or ID). Use browser automation (Selenium, Puppeteer, Playwright, or similar) to: 1. Log into our Trackman Booking & Payments admin dashboard (web-based portal). 2. Navigate to the create-booking section. 3. Fill in and submit the form with the pulled data (select bay, set times, assign customer – customers will already be imported or searchable). 4. Handle basic error checking (e.g., skip if duplicate/conflict, log failures, retry on timeouts). 5. Run reliably as a background script/service (e.g., on a VPS/server, triggered by webhook/poll, with logging/notifications via email/Slack if issues). 6. Optional nice-to-haves: Fuzzy matching for customers, simple dashboard for monitoring. Important notes: 1. Trackman has no public inbound API for creating bookings (only outbound webhooks and limited integrations like HubSpot), so this must use UI automation (web scraping/login/filling forms). 2. Security: The bot will use secure credential storage (env vars, secrets manager); no hardcoding logins. 3. Reliability and stability is critical – needs to handle occasional page changes, CAPTCHAs unlikely but possible, and run 24/7 without crashing. 4. This is for our own internal use only; no scraping public data or violating TOS (we own both accounts). Skills needed: 1. Strong experience with browser automation (Selenium/Python preferred, but Puppeteer/Node.js or Playwright ok). 2. API integration (GymMaster API or Zapier as trigger). 3. Python/Node.js scripting, error handling, scheduling (cron/supervisor/Docker). Bonus: Experience with facility/gym booking systems, RPA tools, or similar sync automations. Budget: $800–$1,500 (depending on polish, testing, and ongoing support). Fixed price preferred, with milestones (e.g., proof-of-concept → full script → deployment/testing). Please include in your proposal: 1. Examples of similar automation bots you've built (especially UI data entry or booking syncs). 2. Tech stack you'd use. 3. Estimated timeline. 4. Any questions about access/testing (I'll provide test accounts/credentials under NDA if needed). Looking for someone reliable who can deliver clean, maintainable code. Let's chat if this matches your experience.

I need it automating so it's upload document, specifcy which one it is, data is pushed to a google sheet. Happy to use AI/LLM or some type of programmatic parsing.
